{{Vanilla|End Rod}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''phosphor rod''' is a thin light source. It is the vanilla {{MCW|End Rod|end rod}}, renamed and given a new recipe that uses [[phosphor]] instead of materials from [[The End]] and [[Hell]], so it can be made early. It gives light level 14 and can be placed facing any direction, as in vanilla.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Three phosphor in the middle column, with glass panes on both sides, make 6 phosphor rods.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/phosphor_rod.json}}</ref> The vanilla recipe, a blaze rod on popped chorus fruit, is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref> The recipe unlocks with the other phosphor recipes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/phosphor.json}}</ref>

=== Natural generation ===
[[End City|End cities]] contain phosphor rods, since they keep the vanilla end rod ID.

== Usage ==
Phosphor rods are used as lighting, as in vanilla.
